source: ClassPad.net Math — exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-19 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project.
notes: Observed on exact ClassPad fx-880BTG PLUS, Vietnamese, LineI/LineO. Every frame retains complete visible LCD and indicator evidence; no regions masked.
Closed power chains use PLUS order: A1=2^(3)^(2)=64, A2=A1+1=65, A3=A1²=4096. Replacing A1 with 3^(2)^(3) gives 729/730/531441.
0^0 is stored with Math ERROR and dependent formulas show ERROR. Setting source formula =0 commits it and warns for A4=1/A1; editing unrelated B1=5 also commits and warns while A4 remains ERROR.
An initial repair attempt while an error dialog was active only acknowledged the error. Its frame was renamed error-acknowledged; the actual repair was observed separately.

Copy A2 then EXE into B2 gives =B1+1, value6, and keeps paste mode. Formula keys and TOOLS are ignored in this mode; repeated EXE pastes relative formulas B3=7 and B4=8. Earlier postfix/menu probe names were corrected to describe these observed paste operations.
After Back cancels paste, actual B3=2^(3)² gives64 and B4=2^(3)⁻¹ gives0.125.

Auto Calc choice menus remain open after selecting a value; Back returns to TOOLS and another Back to the grid. A misdirected source-zero attempt selected/confirmed Off and entered Show Cell; those observations were renamed, and source changes were measured separately from the grid.
With Auto Calc Off, changing A1 to0 retains old dependent values. Manual Recalculate warns and updates A2=1,A3=0,A4=ERROR. Repairing A1 leaves stale dependents until manual Recalculate restores them.
Turning Auto Calc On does not itself recalculate stale values. A later edit does; setting A1 to0 again warns and a fresh repair restores64/65/4096/0.015625.
